Spaceborne GNSS-R Bistatic Radar Remote Sensing, CYGNSS, and Future Missions: This article provides an overview of the use of global navigation satellite system- reflectometry for performing "signals of opportunity" Earth observations. Results from NASA's CYGNSS constellation of small satellites are reviewed, and plans for future developments and deployments are presented.
